info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Compliance Guideline Compliances-spec
info.description: The Compliance Guideline Retrieval API enables users to access established compliance guidelines for banking operations. It provides a structured overview of current compliance specifications, serving as a vital resource for financial institutions ensuring adherence to regulatory standards. Typical consumers include compliance officers, legal teams, and auditors seeking relevant guidelines for their operations. This API supports informed decision-making and enhances risk management by facilitating the integration of compliance requirements into banking practices.

get.description: Fetches the current compliance guidelines for the given resources, providing detailed information on how to align practices with regulatory standards.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve compliance guidelines based on specified criteria. Ensure that the payload structure adheres to the defined schema to obtain the desired compliance information.
